args.subject: Acknowledgment of Quotation Q-1042
args.body:
Dear Shakti Precision Components,

Thank you for submitting Quotation Q-1042 dated for the following items:

1. 9mm brass casings - 500 units @ INR 120 per unit
2. Field radio batteries - 200 units @ INR 850 per unit

We acknowledge receipt of your quotation with 30-day validity and 3-week delivery timeline from Purchase Order.

Our procurement team will review your quotation against our current stock levels and operational requirements. We currently hold sufficient inventory of both items (2,400 units of 9mm brass casings and 1,150 units of field radio batteries) with scheduled dispatches in November 2026.

We will communicate our decision within the validity period. Should you have any queries in the meantime, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Yours faithfully,
Procurement Assistant
Defence Supply Office
